parsed.answer: The signed Kestrel-0 return policy lists two exception identifiers: CUSTOM-0-7c2 for custom-made goods and DEFECT-0-9b4 for quality defects.

citations.quote: custom-made goods use exception CUSTOM-0-7c2; quality defects use exception DEFECT-0-9b4 and are exempt from the 7-day limit.
